name: Camp Riverbend
description_short: Family run day camp on about 30 acres along the Passaic River in Warren for ages 3 to 14. Campers swim twice a day in five heated pools and rotate through sports, high ropes, a ninja course, canoeing, cooking, arts, nature and circus arts; teens in grades 7 to 9 can join Day Trippers for trips around the region.
refund_policy_summary: $500 deposit per camper, of which $200 becomes a non-refundable registration fee. Weeks are final on January 6, 2027; after that, tuition paid is not refundable. Missed days are not credited.
notes: 2027 tuition for in camp grades PreK to 8: 7 weeks $9,000, 6 weeks $8,400, 5 weeks $7,770, 4 weeks $7,000, 3 weeks $5,600, 2 weeks $4,300. Three-Quarter Day (3 year olds, until 2:00) $2,930 to $8,100. Day Trippers (grades 7 to 9) $5,100 to $9,600. Minimum two consecutive weeks. Tuition includes either bus service or extended day (8:00 to 9:00 and 4:00 to 6:00); both cost extra. Camp is closed Monday July 5.
